title: Predicting the geographic distribution of ancient Amazonian archaeological sites with machine learning
summary: Random-forest spatial models trained on mapped Amazonian archaeological sites and environmental/geographic predictors discriminate site classes and estimate their likely distribution. Results are a field-specific archaeological location prediction with spatial validation; the predictions do not establish undiscovered sites without survey.
